stories.headline: Anthropic prices record $81.3B IPO at $83 a share, starts trading today as ANT
stories.summary: Priced above its $70–$78 range, the largest IPO on record, valuing the Claude maker at ~$1.5T fully diluted. Seven tech giants including Google and Nvidia agreed to buy $26B of shares in a private placement.

stories.headline: Nvidia has stopped selling its licensed Hopper chips to China
stories.summary: Interim CEO Colette Kress said on the Nov 17 earnings call that Nvidia has no further licensed Hopper shipments planned, after $2.4B of such sales last quarter. Q3 revenue of $115.8B beat expectations and the board added $150B to the buyback.

stories.headline: GTA 6 is out — live now, and already breaking records
stories.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI went live at midnight local time today on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Presales passed $1.65B / 17M+ copies, and 2M+ people were watching launch streams this morning. One in five US salaried workers planned to take today off to play.

stories.headline: GTA 6 launch live: 99 on Metacritic, New Zealand trick, actors revealed
stories.summary: 99 from 145+ critic reviews, tying Ocarina of Time for the best-reviewed game ever; 2.8M+ watching on Twitch. Lucia and Jason’s actors — Manni L. Perez and Dylan Rourke — finally went public with their roles.

stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first-ever three-way summit in Shenzhen
stories.summary: The three leaders met for 90 minutes at APEC, pledging further talks on nuclear arms, trade and AI. Their joint declaration covered UN reform, more oil production and reducing nuclear risks — but made no mention of Ukraine.

stories.headline: Iran widens Gulf attacks after US strike on Qeshm Island
stories.summary: Iran fired drones at the US air base in Kuwait and launched attacks on Bahrain after US jets hit a Revolutionary Guard missile site on Qeshm Island on Tuesday. No US personnel were injured; a UAE-linked tanker was hit in the Strait of Hormuz, one crew member missing.
stories.source: The Daily Star, via TBS News

stories.headline: Robert Pattinson is the new James Bond
stories.summary: Amazon MGM has officially named Pattinson as 007 — Jeff Bezos says he was heavily involved in the pick after five finalists screen-tested. Christopher Nolan joked he’s “the most cowardly James Bond.”

stories.headline: Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping opens Friday
stories.summary: The prequel opens tomorrow with Francis Lawrence back behind the camera and newcomer Joseph Zada as teenage Haymitch. A 13-year-old’s fan artwork will open every UK screening.
